recipe.build:
cp .env.rb .env
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/ci.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
export PATH="${PATH}:${PWD}/flutter/bin"
flutter config --no-analytics
flutter pub get
dart run flutter_iconpicker:generate_packs --packs fontAwesomeIcons
flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --no-tree-shake-icons
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
OUT="build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release*.apk"
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace $OUT /outputs/unsigned.apk
